brief: product detail card for a luxury watch. Charcoal velvet backdrop. Champagne gold metal accents on the bezel and crown indicators. Ivory typography for the model name and price. Ember-orange hover state on the 'Add to bag' CTA. Two-column layout: left column has the watch image with a soft drop-shadow; right column has the heading, sub-heading (collection name), price, three spec rows (movement, case size, water resistance), and the CTA.
